assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

The record left this cell to a P5b probe of POST /api/session/{id}/background — 'Move active foreground backgroundable tools for this session into background observation' (2.1.4 openapi.json). The probe: the parent starts a task-tool child that runs a shell `sleep 20`; once the child's tool runs (await_child), the driver backgrounds the parent's running tools, waits for the parent's own turn end, and then for the child to drain. Daemon side, read from code: the child is linked (parent_linked) and is exempt from the TTL and same-pid sweeps; whether the parent is held working on a live child after its own hook-ended turn is what the recording shows.

## Measured (this cell's recording)

- The service backgrounded the parent's running task tool: it wrote a `synthetic` row ('User requested that active blocking work be moved to the background') and ended the parent's turn (idle succeeded) while the child's `sleep 20` ran.
- The daemon received the parent's Stop hook and kept the parent working — held on its live child — until the child's own Stop hook and ready; the parent went ready 19ms after the child.
- When the child completed, the service injected a `synthetic` `<subagent … state="completed">` row into the parent and ran one more parent turn (its own working → Stop hook → ready) — new activity, not a bounce.

## Spec choices (the scenario's unified rule)

- The parent's own Stop hook lands while the child still runs (the child's ready comes AFTER it).
- The parent is held working until the child drains: its ready comes after the child's.
caveats: After the child drains, OpenCode runs one more parent turn to deliver the child's result (a `synthetic` row), so the parent shows working → ready once more; the spec ends at the parent's first post-drain ready.
The 2.x parser has no branch for `synthetic` rows; the transcript-only golden replays the user/assistant/idle rows around them.

sources.note: 2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)
2.1.4 API: POST /api/session/{id}/background moves running backgroundable tools into background observation

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
settings allow the shell tool in RUN_CWD/opencode.json
send; await_child until the child's shell tool runs; background the parent's running tools; wait for the parent's turn end; 30s for the child to drain

script.text: Use the task tool to launch a subagent (the built-in 'general' agent) that runs the shell command `sleep 20` and then replies with exactly the word: finished.

verify: the parent's turn ends while the child still runs
the parent session stays working until the child drains, then goes ready
